cards.text: Casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.
cards.author: 1 Peter 5:7

cards.text: For we walk by faith, not by sight.
cards.author: 2 Corinthians 5:7

cards.text: What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
cards.author: Romans 8:31

cards.text: Echando toda vuestra solicitud en él, porque él tiene cuidado de vosotros.
cards.author: 1 Pedro 5:7

cards.text: Porque por fe andamos, no por vista.
cards.author: 2 Corintios 5:7

cards.text: ¿Pues qué diremos á esto? Si Dios por nosotros, ¿quién contra nosotros?
cards.author: Romanos 8:31

cards.text: Lançando sobre ele toda a vossa ansiedade; porque ele tem cuidado de vós.
cards.author: 1 Pedro 5:7

cards.text: Pois andamos pela fé, e não pela vista.
cards.author: 2 Coríntios 5:7

cards.text: Então, que diremos acerca dessas coisas? Se Deus é por nós, quem será contra nós?
cards.author: Romanos 8:31

cards.text: Alle Sorge werfet auf ihn; denn er sorgt für euch.
cards.author: 1. Petrus 5:7

cards.text: Denn wir wandeln im Glauben, und nicht im Schauen.
cards.author: 2 Korinther 5:7

cards.text: Was wollen wir nun hierzu sagen? Ist Gott für uns, wer mag wider uns sein?
cards.author: Römer 8:31

cards.text: Et déchargez-vous sur lui de tous vos soucis, car lui-même prend soin de vous.
cards.author: 1 Pierre 5:7

cards.text: Car nous marchons par la foi et non par la vue.
cards.author: 2 Corinthiens 5:7

cards.text: Que dirons-nous donc à l’égard de ces choses? Si Dieu est pour nous, qui sera contre nous?
cards.author: Romains 8:31

cards.text: Gettando su lui ogni vostra sollecitudine, perch’Egli ha cura di voi.
cards.author: 1 Pietro 5:7

cards.text: Poiché camminiamo per fede e non per visione.
cards.author: 2 Corinzi 5:7

cards.text: Che diremo dunque a queste cose? Se Dio è per noi, chi sarà contro di noi?
cards.author: Romani 8:31

ja.pill: 神は私を愛しています。

cards.text: 又もろもろの心勞を神に委ねよ、神なんぢらの爲に慮ぱかり給へばなり。
cards.author: ペトロの手紙一 5:7

cards.text: 見ゆる所によらず、信仰によりて歩めばなり。
cards.author: コリントの信徒への手紙二 5:7

cards.text: 然れば此 等の事につきて何をか言はん、神もし我らの味方ならば、誰か我らに敵せんや。
cards.author: ローマの信徒への手紙 8:31

cards.text: 너희 염려를 다 주께 맡겨 버리라 이는 저가 너희를 권고하심이니라
cards.author: 베드로전서 5:7

cards.text: 이는 우리가 믿음으로 행하고 보는 것으로 하지 아니함이로라
cards.author: 고린도후서 5:7

cards.text: 그런즉 이 일에 대하여 우리가 무슨 말 하리요 만일 하나님이 우리를 위하시면 누가 우리를 대적하리요
cards.author: 로마서 8:31

cards.text: Serahkanlah segala kuatirmu kepada-Nya, karena Ialah yang memperdulikan kamu.
cards.author: 1 Petrus 5:7

cards.text: Karena perjalanan kami dengan iman, bukannya dengan penglihatan.
cards.author: 2 Korintus 5:7

cards.text: Sekarang apakah hendak kita katakan atas segala hal itu? Jikalau Allah memihak kita, siapakah lawan kita?
cards.author: Roma 8:31

cards.text: Bütün kaygılarınızı O’na bırakın, çünkü O sizi kayırır.
cards.author: 1. Petrus 5:7

cards.text: Çünkü imanla yürüyoruz, gözle değil.
cards.author: 2 Korintliler 5:7

cards.text: Öyleyse bu şeyler için ne diyelim? Eğer Tanrı bizden yanaysa, kim bize karşı olabilir?
cards.author: Romalılar 8:31

cards.text: Wszystkie wasze troski przerzućcie na niego, gdyż on troszczy się o was.
cards.author: 1 List Piotra 5:7

cards.text: Przez wiarę bowiem kroczymy, a nie przez widzenie.
cards.author: 2 List do Koryntian 5:7

cards.text: Cóż więc na to powiemy? Jeśli Bóg za nami, któż przeciwko nam?
cards.author: List do Rzymian 8:31

cards.text: Na inyong ilagak sa kaniya ang lahat ng inyong kabalisahan, sapagka't kayo'y ipinagmamalasakit niya.
cards.author: 1 Pedro 5:7

cards.text: Sapagka't nagsisilakad kami sa pamamagitan ng pananampalataya, hindi sa pamamagitan ng paningin.
cards.author: 2 Mga Taga-Corinto 5:7

cards.text: Ano ang ating sasabihin sa mga bagay na ito? Kung ang Dios ay kakampi natin, sino ang laban sa atin?
cards.author: Mga Taga-Roma 8:31

cards.text: अपनी सारी चिन्ता उसी पर डाल दो, क्योंकि उसको तुम्हारा ध्यान है।
cards.author: 1 पतरस 5:7

cards.text: क्योंकि हम रूप को देखकर नहीं, पर विश्वास से चलते हैं।
cards.author: 2 कुरिन्थियों 5:7

cards.text: तो हम इन बातों के विषय में क्या कहें? यदि परमेश्वर हमारी ओर है, तो हमारा विरोधी कौन हो सकता है?
cards.author: रोमियों 8:31

cards.text: Aruncând toată îngrijorarea voastră asupra lui, pentru că el se îngrijește de voi.
cards.author: 1 Petru 5:7

cards.text: Fiindcă umblăm prin credință, nu prin vedere.
cards.author: 2 Corinteni 5:7

cards.text: Ce vom spune atunci față de acestea? Dacă Dumnezeu este pentru noi, cine poate fi împotriva noastră?
cards.author: Romani 8:31

cards.text: Werpt al uw bekommernis op Hem, want Hij zorgt voor u.
cards.author: 1 Petrus 5:7

cards.text: Want wij wandelen door geloof en niet door aanschouwen.
cards.author: 2 Corinthiërs 5:7

cards.text: Wat zullen wij dan tot deze dingen zeggen? Zo God voor ons is, wie zal tegen ons zijn?
cards.author: Romeinen 8:31

cards.text: Všelikou péči svou uvrhouce na něj. Nebo on má péči o vás.
cards.author: 1. list Petrův 5:7

cards.text: Nebo skrze víru chodíme, ne skrze vidění.
cards.author: 2. list Korintským 5:7

cards.text: Což tedy díme k tomu? Kdyžť jest Bůh s námi, i kdo proti nám?
cards.author: Římanům 8:31

cards.text: Svu svoju brigu povjerite njemu jer on se brine za vas.
cards.author: 1 Petrova 5:7

cards.text: Ta u vjeri hodimo, ne u gledanju.
cards.author: 2 Korinćanima 5:7

cards.text: Što ćemo dakle na to reći? Ako je Bog za nas, tko će protiv nas?
cards.author: Rimljanima 8:31

cards.text: Minden gondotokat ő reá vessétek, mert néki gondja van reátok.
cards.author: 1 Péter 5:7

cards.text: Mert hitben járunk, nem látásban.
cards.author: 2 Korinthus 5:7

cards.text: Mit mondunk azért ezekre? Ha az Isten velünk, kicsoda ellenünk?
cards.author: Róma 8:31

cards.text: Vso skrb svojo zvrnite nanj, ker on skrbi za vas.
cards.author: 1 Peter 5:7

cards.text: Zakaj po veri živimo, ne po tem, kar gledamo.
cards.author: 2 Korinčanom 5:7

cards.text: Kaj torej porečemo na to? Če je Bog z nami, kdo je proti nam?
cards.author: Rimljanom 8:31

cards.text: Och »kasten alla edra bekymmer på honom», ty han har omsorg om eder.
cards.author: 1 Petrusbrevet 5:7

cards.text: Ty vi vandra här i tro och icke i åskådning.
cards.author: 2 Korintierbrevet 5:7

cards.text: Vad skola vi nu säga härom? Är Gud för oss, vem kan då vara emot oss?
cards.author: Romarbrevet 8:31

cards.text: Og kast all eders sorg på ham! for han har omsorg for eder.
cards.author: 1 Peter 5:7

cards.text: For vi vandrer i tro, ikke i beskuelse.
cards.author: 2 Korinter 5:7

cards.text: Hvad skal vi da si til dette? Er Gud for oss, hvem er da imot oss?
cards.author: Romerne 8:31
